title: Scholia course
description: content/courses/<id>/course.json: one opening taught from one side. Its lessons are the JSON files in lessons/ beside it.

id.description: Must match the directory name, conventionally "<opening>-<stance>".

title.description: e.g. "Playing the Traxler" or "Facing the Traxler".

learner.description: The side the learner plays; every lesson must match.

stance.description: "wield": the learner plays the opening's idea. "face": the learner meets it.

status.description: backlog → researching (tree and sources being built) → ready (enough sources to teach) → drafting → review → published (every lesson reviewed, no problems).

overview.description: "About this opening". Citations' `at` is relative to the opening's root.
